# Rust supplier contract (reference crate)

This is a verbatim copy of the legacy `content_suppliers_rust/rust` crate + `flutter_rust_bridge.yaml`.
It is the **source of truth** for the FFI contract between the app and the external supplier modules
(`strumok_suppliers` 4.x). See [../spec-02-content-suppliers-ffi.md](../../../instructions/spec-02-content-suppliers-ffi.instructions.md).

```text
content_suppliers_rust/
├── flutter_rust_bridge.yaml      rust_input: crate::api, rust_root: rust/, dart_output: lib/rust
└── rust/
    ├── Cargo.toml                flutter_rust_bridge = "=2.12.0", crate-type cdylib+staticlib
    ├── Cargo.lock
    └── src/
        ├── lib.rs
        ├── api/mod.rs            ◀ CONTRACT: exported functions (funcId order is derived from here)
        ├── models.rs             ◀ CONTRACT: transferred types
        ├── frb_generated.rs      generated by FRB 2.12.0 (content hash -1122641696)
        └── suppliers/
            ├── mod.rs            ContentSupplier / MangaPagesLoader traits, enum dispatch, registry
            └── dummy.rs          test supplier "dummy" (ignored by FRB)
```

## Invariants

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| FRB codegen | `2.12.0` |
| `FLUTTER_RUST_BRIDGE_CODEGEN_CONTENT_HASH` | `-1122641696` |
| Compatible bundle major | `4` |
| sha256 `rust/src/api/mod.rs` | `ac26e23fdd971a43388001d8f429b247073c95f2440f968cad1488a71013b69b` |
| sha256 `rust/src/models.rs` | `0f707d099833a78908ca460023aca7025d5dd04e9e456bbfdab5d84556b0df9f` |
| sha256 `rust/src/frb_generated.rs` | `9695e81241b0e20478af5e9d7225e4be27f0f04de95ded96d3a61cd825cb4fd8` |

Verify in the new repo:

```bash
cd packages/content_suppliers_rust
sha256sum rust/src/api/mod.rs rust/src/models.rs rust/src/frb_generated.rs
grep -n "CONTENT_HASH: i32 = -1122641696" rust/src/frb_generated.rs
```

## Rules

- **Do not modify** `api/mod.rs`, `models.rs` or `frb_generated.rs`. Changing names, argument order, types,
  enum variants or field order changes the content hash and/or `funcId`s and the published modules will not load.
- The external modules (separate `strumok_suppliers` repo) implement the same `api` and `models` with the same hash;
  `suppliers/` here only contains the `dummy` supplier for tests.
- The Dart counterpart (`content_suppliers_rust/lib/rust/*.dart` generated bindings and `lib/bundle.dart`, plus
  the `content_suppliers_api` package) must still be copied from the legacy repo unchanged.

## Building the dummy library (for the FFI smoke test)

```bash
cd packages/content_suppliers_rust/rust
cargo build --release          # → target/release/libcontent_suppliers_rust.so (Linux) / content_suppliers_rust.dll
```

Note: in the legacy repo `suppliers/dummy.rs` did not compile (missing `hls_proxy` in one `Video` initializer).
This copy adds `hls_proxy: false` there. `dummy.rs` is excluded from FRB codegen (`flutter_rust_bridge:ignore`),
so the content hash is unaffected.
